description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter component in the OpenClaw project. It tests session matching logic, fallback behaviors based on activity and configuration, and decision-making for user prompts related to command execution permissions.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompterTests
classes.description: A structure containing multiple test cases to validate behavior of ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter.

methods.name: session match prefers active session
methods.description: Tests whether the system correctly determines to present prompts when the active session matches the requested session.

methods.name: session fallback uses recent activity
methods.description: Validates fallback logic that prompts based on recent user activity when no active session is present.

methods.name: default behavior matches mode
methods.description: Verifies that the default prompting behavior aligns with the specified mode (local or remote).

methods.name: askAlwaysPromptsRegardlessOfSecurity
methods.description: Ensures prompts are always asked regardless of security settings when 'ask' is set to 'always'.

methods.name: askOnMissPromptsOnlyForAllowlist
methods.description: Checks that prompts are only shown for allowlist security when 'ask' is set to 'onMiss'.

methods.name: askOffNeverPrompts
methods.description: Ensures that no prompts are made when 'ask' is set to 'off' for any security configuration.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistAllowsMatchingResolvedPath
methods.description: Tests whether command paths matching allowlist patterns are permitted when fallback decision is 'allowlist'.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistDeniesAllowlistMiss
methods.description: Verifies that unmatched allowlist patterns result in denial when fallback decision is 'allowlist'.

methods.name: fallbackFullAllowsWhenPromptCannotBeShown
methods.description: Checks that full prompting fallback allows commands when the prompt cannot be shown.
